title: Long NVDA — Post-Earnings Continuation
entry: Initiate $225-$232 on first 15-min consolidation after Thursday open. Require pre-market $226+ hold to confirm the AH bid. Do NOT chase a gap-up above $235.
stop_loss: $210 daily close (adjusted from $215 as stock consolidated below entry range; $213–217 accumulation zone invalidated; May 28 close $211.34 above adjusted stop)
risk_reward: 1:3 to first target ($10 risk vs $19-25 reward)
catalyst: Q1 FY27 revenue $81.6B vs $79.2B est (+$2.4B beat); Q2 guide $91B vs $86B est ($5B above consensus, $1B above whisper); data center $75.2B nearly doubled YoY; Jensen: 'Demand has gone parabolic.'
thesis: The single highest-conviction long in the AI complex. The print resolved the binary event with a clean beat AND a massive Q2 guide — the kind of two-leg confirmation that re-rates the multiple. The initial -2% AH sell-the-news followed by recovery to +1.93% is the textbook pattern when expectations were extreme: the stock has to digest the run-up before continuation. Blackwell at 9GW deployed, Rubin samples shipping, $49B FCF record, 74.9% GM — every operational metric checked the box. The structural setup: $91B Q2 guide implies 15% sequential growth, the strongest Blackwell quarter yet. AI capex is not decelerating; it's accelerating into Q3. The entry isn't the AH print — it's the first consolidation after Thursday's open, when the gap-chasers get flushed out and the trend re-engages.
bull_case: NVDA holds $226+ pre-market, semis complex opens up 2-4% on read-through, mid-morning breakout above $232 confirms continuation. Asian institutional bid Thursday night drives $235+ gap, Friday consolidation, then $245 by next week. Within 4-8 weeks: SPCX IPO concerns priced in, Warsh June FOMC neutral-to-dovish, $258 target tags. Stretch case: Rubin demand commentary at next earnings re-rates multiple to $280+.
bear_case: The 'beats and drops' pattern (NVDA averages -2.93% next-day post-earnings over last 5 reports) reasserts. NVDA opens below $220 Thursday, gap fills to $215 by Friday close — stops triggered. Macro: 30Y spikes above 5.20% on hot PCE May 27, kills the rate-sensitive AI bid. Structural: SpaceX IPO June 12 drains $75B of institutional risk capital from AI longs. Sentiment: 'peak AI capex' narrative re-emerges if any hyperscaler signals capex moderation in Q2.
invalidation: Daily close below $215, OR SPX below 7,400 with VIX above 18 for 2 consecutive sessions

outcome.outcome_label: Stop triggered — NVDA closed $204.04 on June 6, below $210 stop
outcome.note: NVDA closed at $204.04 on Friday June 6, 2026, decisively below the $210 daily-close stop. Broad semis weakness — AMD −10.86% to ~$466, TSM −6.69% to ~$415 — overwhelmed the stock despite NVDA's AI story remaining intact. The post-earnings continuation thesis required a regime where SPX held above 7,460 and semis led; instead four regime triggers breached. NVDA opened $214.53 on Monday June 8 on the MRVL/Jensen AI catalyst but the Friday daily-close stop is determinative. Return from reference price $221.79 to final close $204.04 = −8.0%.
